title: Leaf Wetness Disease-Risk Duration
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plant:sensor sensor_type=leaf_wetness
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(leaf_wetness=1)) as wet_hours, avg(temp_c) as avg_temp_c by zone _time
| where wet_hours>8 AND avg_temp_c>10
| sort - wet_hours
description: Uses Leaf-wetness garden sensors telemetry to monitor how long foliage stayed wet under disease-friendly temperatures in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for conditions that favor mildew or fungal pressure, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Leaf-wetness garden sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long foliage stayed wet under disease-friendly temperatures so you can spot conditions that favor mildew or fungal pressure before it becomes annoying.
